title: RegisterRunOrchestrationExtension
description: Extension fields added to the existing POST /api/zekt/register-run request body to support orchestration. All fields are optional — their absence means this is a standard non-orchestrated run and existing behavior is unchanged. zekt-action v3 populates orchestration_step_ref automatically by reading client_payload._zekt from $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH when running inside a repository_dispatch-triggered workflow.
$comment: This schema documents only the NEW fields. The existing register-run required fields (zekt_run_id, zekt_step_id, zekt_payload) are unchanged.

zekt_run_id.description: Existing field — GitHub workflow run ID (GITHUB_RUN_ID). Included here for completeness.

zekt_step_id.description: Existing field — always 'default' for standard action calls.

zekt_payload.description: Existing field — arbitrary output payload from the provider service workflow. When this run is part of an orchestration, the root properties of this object become the outputs for the step, available as ${{ steps.N.outputs.FIELD }} in downstream steps.
zekt_payload.$comment: Max size enforced at 256 KB when orchestration_step_ref is present (tighter than the standard 512 KB limit).

orchestration_step_ref.description: NEW — present only when this register-run call originates from a provider service workflow that was dispatched as part of an orchestration. Null or absent for all standard (non-orchestrated) runs.

OrchestrationStepRef.description: Identifies which orchestration step this workflow run is fulfilling. Extracted by zekt-action v3 from client_payload._zekt.orchestration in the triggering repository_dispatch event.

execution_id.description: The orchestration execution ID this run belongs to. Mirrors OrchestrationContext.executionId from the dispatch payload.

step_id.description: The step_id within the orchestration this run is fulfilling. Mirrors OrchestrationContext.stepId from the dispatch payload.

examples.$comment: Standard non-orchestrated call — no change to existing behavior
Orchestrated call — zekt-action v3 auto-populates orchestration_step_ref from GITHUB_EVENT_PATH
